title: WorkingColorFormat
description: The internal storage the scene renders into before the output transform. `'sdr'` (the default) is the existing eight-bit `Rgba8Srgb` working target. `'hdr'` allocates an `Rgba16F` working target instead, so a value above display white survives every intermediate pass instead of clamping before the tone map ever sees it - it does not change the output transform's own math, which already operates on unbounded linear input.
